translations.web: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.
translations.bsb: So the king of Israel sent word to the place the man of God had pointed out. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.
